title: NeoForge Command Blocker
description: A mod that blocks selected commands from being used on a world/server (even for OP's and server console)
body:
# Neoforge Command Blocker
Have you ever ran a server where you wanted to block commands from being used, whether it's from stopping players from using /seed or stopping OP's abusing commands like /tp or perhaps it's to prevent yourself from reaching into the temptation of going into creative mode. Well fret no more. This mod allows you to do just that.

## How to use
On a server you can ban commands in the mod's config commandlocker-common.toml by typing into the square brackets the command you want to block (remember to use "") ie ["tp"] 

or if you want to block multiple commands just add a ',' ie ["tp", "gamemode"].

Sub commands can be blocked instead of banning the full command for example ["tp", "teleport", "gamemode creative", "ban User"]

This mod can be used in a singleplayer world too with an in game config screen accessed via Mods → Command Locker → Config.

### You do not need to restart your server for the config to be updated.
The commands will be blocked on saving the config file
